So, first things first: if there are any orders that haven’t shipped or haven’t arrived at my place yet, please cancel those immediately. I can’t afford to receive them right now. Then, for the orders that have already been delivered, I want to return everything. But here’s the thing—I really don’t remember exactly what I bought in those delivered orders. My mind is just all over the place with everything going on. So could you please pull up the delivered orders and list out the items for me first, before we actually process any returns?

I’ve been shopping with you all for years as a loyal customer, and I feel terrible even asking for this, but I really need the money back right now.

turns.thought:
I'm sorry to hear you're going through a rough patch — I'll do whatever I can within what I'm able to help with.
